sentences.japanese: 君の市の人口は私の町の人口の約５倍だ。
sentences.english: The population of your city is about five times as large as that of my town.

sentences.japanese: 紀元２０２０年までには、この市の人口は倍増しているだろう。
sentences.english: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.

sentences.japanese: 楽隊が先頭に立って市を行進した。
sentences.english: A band led the parade through the city.

sentences.japanese: 我々の市は東京の３分の１の人口です。
sentences.english: Our city has one third as many people as Tokyo.

sentences.japanese: 横浜は日本で２番目に人口が多い市だ。
sentences.english: Yokohama is the city in Japan with the second largest population.
